# Greater Hartford

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** Hartford and its suburbs, from New Britain to Enfield and Storrs, the northeastern corner of Connecticut around Putnam and Danielson, and the Northwest Hills around Torrington and Winsted. The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: Hartford, Northeastern Connecticut or Northwest Hills.

**Counties:** Capitol Planning Region, CT; Northeastern Connecticut Planning Region, CT; Northwest Hills Planning Region, CT. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county (in Connecticut, its planning region), or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#greater-hartford)

## Operators

| Operator | Runs | Real-time | Key needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Connecticut DOT | CTtransit buses, CTfastrak among them; CTrail Hartford Line trains | CTtransit buses | No |
| Amtrak | Trains in the area | No | No |
| Pioneer Valley Transit Authority (PVTA) | Bus from Springfield to Enfield | Yes | No |
| Northeastern Connecticut Transit District (NECTD, through Arcadis) | Buses in Putnam, Thompson, Killingly, Brooklyn and Plainfield | No | No |
| Windham Region Transit District (WRTD, through Passio) | Buses in Storrs and at the University of Connecticut, and from Willimantic to Danielson | Yes | No |
| Northwestern Connecticut Transit District (NWCTD, through Arcadis) | Buses in Torrington and Winsted, and to Bantam and Canaan | No | No |
